name: Dragon Freedom (Crew-12)
about: Dragon Freedom (Crew-12) (2026-031A), a crewed vehicle (Dragon 2), launched 2026 Feb 13. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2026 Feb 14), held fixed
docked to A09460; it stays docked here until it lands; the undocking is folded into the landing (a fudge of hours)
the landing time is GCAT's end of mission (psatcat TDate); the point stands in for the programme's usual recovery area, from memory

events.why: the hour is GCAT's; the site is estimated
